exposure: surgical management (radical vulvectomy, lymphadenectomy, V-Y flap, reoperations for recurrence and complications)
cohort: A single 57-year-old postmenopausal woman diagnosed with Extramammary Vulvar Paget's disease in 2014, who experienced a recurrence in 2023.
finding: A 57-year-old postmenopausal woman with recurrent Extramammary Vulvar Paget's disease underwent successful surgical treatment, including reoperations for complications, with no further recurrence or deterioration observed at 6-month follow-up.
